experiments.title: Normal ship cargo unloading baseline
experiments.hypothesis: A valid command sequence produces ordered valve feedback, pump feedback, flow rise, ship-tank level fall and measurable electrical demand.

experiments.title: Blocked transfer path with pump running
experiments.hypothesis: Pump and valve feedback may remain healthy while measured hydraulic flow collapses; process-aware evidence distinguishes blockage from command failure.

experiments.title: Flow measurement integrity anomaly
experiments.hypothesis: A deterministic sensor bias creates a residual between measured flow and mass-balance flow while command/feedback remain normal.

experiments.title: Generator trip and cross-system response
experiments.hypothesis: Loss of generation causes a frequency/reserve excursion and may trigger load shedding that propagates to dependent Cargo/Machinery states.

experiments.title: Cooling impairment and high-temperature protection
experiments.hypothesis: At sustained load, deterministic cooling impairment drives coolant temperature across the protective threshold and the PLC removes engine permission.

experiments.title: Unexpected Modbus control source
experiments.hypothesis: A Modbus client outside the documented conduit is objectively classified as unexpected from network evidence.

experiments.title: Cargo supervisory publication outage
experiments.hypothesis: Loss of the operations-side OPC UA path stops fresh historian samples while the Cargo Modbus control conduit remains available.
